items.title: De De Pierce Interview, 1960-01-10
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Glenny used to say that all the time.

ctx.x: Glenny used to say that all the time. Oh, no, no, no. He said his mother could hardly speak English, and she'd say, some fellow, she's waiting not to see you. Say, can't you get another bass player? Bosses, yeah. Let's see. Let's see. What have we got now? I think we've got pretty much everything in the rhythm section, haven't we?
Yeah, I think that's all. Yeah, piano.
